scope: Fortnite — échéances générales, billetterie et lifecycle compétitif route-aware avec rappels conditionnels

principles.deadline_not_end_only: Une échéance peut être ouverture/fermeture d'inscription, check-in, dernière session qualificative, vente, dernière session publique ou fin de passe.
principles.milestone_not_deadline: Ouverture, début de qualifier, résultat, qualification résolue et début de finale sont des milestones distincts des deadlines dures.
principles.policy_state_separation: Ce fichier conserve l'état persistant ; les règles V3 sont définies dans fortnite-competitive-deadline-engine-france.json.
principles.route_aware: Une compétition peut avoir plusieurs routes vers une cible : qualifier primaire, second qualifier, LCQ, points de série, invitation ou accès direct.
principles.conditional_notices: Un rappel participant peut rester DORMANT tant que sa condition n'est pas vérifiée, puis être ARMED sans recréer un événement calendrier.
principles.result_finality: Résultats provisoires, qualification finale et correction officielle sont distincts.
principles.participant_separation: La résolution globale d'une phase ne prouve jamais à elle seule le résultat d'un joueur/roster précis.
principles.no_absence_inference: L'absence d'un nom, d'une page ou d'un crawl n'est jamais une preuve d'élimination.
principles.no_scarcity_inference: Une échéance proche ne prouve aucune rareté de billets.
principles.quiet_hours: 21:00–09:00 Europe/Paris pour les notices non urgentes ; ne différer que si l'information reste actionnable.

competitive_lifecycle_policy.skip_allowed: Invitation/direct final may skip registration/qualifier only when official structure supports it.
competitive_lifecycle_policy.registration_closed: Never infer registration close from session start without an explicit official rule/state.
competitive_lifecycle_policy.qualifier_complete: All relevant official qualifier sessions must be complete/resolved enough; missing/postponed sessions block premature resolution.
competitive_lifecycle_policy.result_provisional: Use when standings exist but result finality is not sufficient to resolve advancement conclusively.
competitive_lifecycle_policy.qualification_pending: Use after play completion when final advancement is still unresolved.
competitive_lifecycle_policy.qualification_resolved: Requires sufficiently final official evidence plus a verified graph/rule.
competitive_lifecycle_policy.final_scheduled: Requires a known target plus official usable date/window.
competitive_lifecycle_policy.postponement: Keeps stable IDs and invalidates obsolete future timing notices until rescheduled.

route_state_policy.failed_path_not_event_elimination: FAILED_ROUTE only ends that route. ELIMINATED_EVENT is invalid while another official active route to the same target remains.
route_state_policy.lcq_guard: A sourced LCQ/secondary route remains eligible for reminders after primary failure when participant eligibility is still satisfied.
route_state_policy.unknown_route_guard: Never invent a future LCQ because one existed historically.

participant_outcome_policy.provisional_guard: PROVISIONAL results may update rank/points and PENDING/ACTIVE only; permanent event elimination requires final enough official evidence.
participant_outcome_policy.qualified: Means qualified to the referenced target, not merely advanced to another qualifier phase.
participant_outcome_policy.advanced: Means progressed to another non-final phase.
participant_outcome_policy.eliminated_path: One route is conclusively lost; other routes may remain.
participant_outcome_policy.eliminated_event: No official route remains and final official evidence supports non-qualification.
participant_outcome_policy.on_qualified: Suppress unused alternative qualifier reminders and arm only future participant-specific final reminders.
participant_outcome_policy.on_eliminated_path: Suppress only that route's reminders and recalculate next action from remaining routes.
participant_outcome_policy.on_eliminated_event: Invalidate participant PLAY/REGISTER/CHECK_IN downstream reminders, preserve global WATCH/ATTEND.
participant_outcome_policy.correction: Official correction creates superseding outcome/history and recalculates future reminders.

conditional_notice_policy.no_backfill: When conditions become true late, arm future triggers only.
conditional_notice_policy.register: Arm only while route registration is actionable and participant is not already registered/qualified/eliminated_event.
conditional_notice_policy.check_in: Arm only for registered participant with official check-in and active route.
conditional_notice_policy.qualifier: Arm only for active/ready route with usable session timing.
conditional_notice_policy.lcq: Arm only if LCQ exists officially, participant remains eligible, and participant is not already qualified.
conditional_notice_policy.final: Arm only if participant is QUALIFIED to that target and the final timing is official/future.
conditional_notice_policy.suppression_reversible: SUPPRESSED_CONDITION may return to ARMED before trigger if conditions become true again and version is still valid.

dedupe.deadline_key: competition_id + route_id-or-phase_id + session_id-or-null + participant_id-or-global + type + at + lifecycle_version + route_version
dedupe.participant_outcome_key: participant_id + competition_id + phase_id + route_id-or-null + state + qualification_target + result_fingerprint

invalidation_rules.registration_extended: Increment route/lifecycle/deadline version, invalidate old future registration notices and recalculate.
invalidation_rules.session_rescheduled: Keep session_id, invalidate notices tied to old timing, recalculate from new official timing.
invalidation_rules.route_failed: Suppress only notices for that route unless no other official route remains.
invalidation_rules.qualified_elsewhere: Suppress alternative qualifier/LCQ participant play reminders; preserve global watch/attend.
invalidation_rules.qualification_target_changed: Invalidate false downstream reminders and recalculate from corrected graph.
invalidation_rules.participant_eliminated_event: Invalidate participant-specific PLAY/REGISTER/CHECK_IN downstream notices only.
invalidation_rules.postponed: Invalidate timing-dependent notices until new official timing exists.
invalidation_rules.cancelled: Invalidate all future notices in scope.

history.note: Global Championship is a directly scheduled championship; no registration/qualifier steps are invented.
V3 models the known championship as a DIRECT_FINAL route without changing canonical competition facts.
Championship run is live; exact match-time milestones remain unavailable because only a date range is trusted.
V3 represents the championship as a DIRECT_FINAL live route.
Historical LCQ sessions are complete; advancement is not upgraded beyond stored evidence.
Historical LCQ is modeled as a route with RESULT_PENDING because participant/final advancement is not sufficiently resolved in the persistent data.
